lines.t: In the vestibule, the spirit's tone
Law may flesh, yet grave may known
He taught by walking, step and flame
Every D called us by name
Heart and sin where peace remains
He's the Lord of the Sabbath
He's the Lord completed When mercy gathers round
Lift your eyes to Heaven's breath Rest, rejoice, and find your death
He's the Lord, Lord of grace
Oh, church is a man, hear the refrain Return to truth, break every chain
If he obeyed what was divine Why drift away from holy time?
Echoes fall through synth and sky Still his call goes floating by
He is the gold, the Torah name, the flame that cannot die
Reverb holds into his name, faith drifts into the sky
He's the Lord of the Sabbath, who shadows light his founts
